title: Does Increasing Atmospheric Carbon Dioxide Facilitate Plant Invasions?
content: Elevated CO2 alters resource allocation, which should benefit species that produce metabolically expensive specialized metabolites (in orange). Increasing biochemical production will have consequences for plant competition, plant-soil feedbacks, and ecosystem processes, and can create fitness advantages for these species over species that do not produce these chemicals (in black).
